title: Chat with a volunteer
subtitle: A chapter volunteer answers in person
intro: Tell us your first name and what you would like to talk about. The next available volunteer will pick up.
noAnswer: Nobody could pick up right now. Please ask the assistant instead, or write to office@coachingfederation.ch.
ended: The conversation has ended. Thank you for talking to us.
offlineNotice: No volunteer is on duty right now — the assistant is happy to help.
error: Something went wrong. Please try again, or write to office@coachingfederation.ch.
privacy: You are talking to a chapter volunteer. The transcript is deleted after 30 days.
